setupTasks.name: Instalar Node 24 y dependencias
setupTasks.command: bash -lc 'source /usr/local/share/nvm/nvm.sh && nvm install 24 && nvm alias default 24 && npm install'

start.name: Actualizar desde GitHub y arrancar Angular
start.command: bash -lc 'git fetch -q origin main && git reset -q --hard origin/main; source /usr/local/share/nvm/nvm.sh && nvm install 24 >/dev/null && nvm use 24 && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx ng serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200'
